end.summary:
Practised ordering BCE and CE dates on a timeline.
Aarav correctly ordered 3000 BCE, 500 BCE, 100 CE, and 1947 CE.
Discussed that BCE years count down towards 1 BCE.
Practised checking historical claims against sources and why historians cross-check.
Teach-back was not passed; the BCE-to-CE transition remained a question at the end.
end.parentNote: Asha practised timeline ordering using the method of comparing BCE years in reverse order and placing CE dates to the right. Aarav explained that historians cross-check a source because it may present only one person’s account. Aarav mixed up the exact transition around 1 BCE and 1 CE, and this was not confirmed as corrected in the lesson. At home, use a short number-line activity with 3 BCE, 1 BCE, 1 CE, and 3 CE, then ask Aarav to explain the order aloud.
